text: Exploratory mechanism: at the EXP-001 setting, greedy gives the hardest third of items 5.326 reviews and the easiest third 2.714 (uniform 4 and 4), with the same mean review day as uniform (14.065) and a slightly earlier mean last-review day (23.978 vs 24.180); its gain comes from reallocation to hard items, not from recency.
limitations: Simulated learners only; conditional on the assumed memory model, which does not beat a constant predictor of real first-review recall (CAL-002); not a claim about human learners. Measured at the central cell only; not at k = 2.

text: Exploratory: EXP-003 instability survives a resolved criterion: 70 of 72 cells have a reversal whose pairwise 95% bootstrap interval excludes 0 (54 of 56 without the 16 ceiling cells); the top arm is resolved in 59 cells (massed 28, greedy 15, expanding 14, uniform 2); under the power law massed is top in 24 of 36 cells.
limitations: Simulated learners only; conditional on the assumed memory model, which does not beat a constant predictor of real first-review recall (CAL-002); not a claim about human learners. Ceiling threshold 0.95 is post hoc; pairwise intervals unadjusted.

text: Calibration and model fit: per-word half-lives fitted on the calibration split of DS01 give h0 = 54.0 days and sigma = 0.759 (validation split 55.2 days and 0.721); on held-out first-review recall neither forgetting family beats a constant predictor (log-loss per trial: constant 0.328, best exponential 0.549, best power law 0.428).
limitations: Duolingo 2013 learners and words only; first-review recall only.

text: Central retention interval: RI = 281 days was selected by a pre-stated rule from the uniform arm alone (baseline mean R 0.550 on exploratory seeds 1-30; 0.680 under the power law).
limitations: A design choice to leave the ceiling, not a typical use case.
